# Dragon and flames — animation 2

The transparent eight-pose PNG was created with the built-in imagegen tool on October 19, 2026 for the second game-end animation. It is bundled locally. The renderer isolates the eight connected silhouettes once; no model, image download or remote animation is needed during play. The app draws fire, embers and the defeated chess king with Canvas. The ending holds the dragon alone, without adding a winning king or stars. The original samurai remains animation 1.

Each decisive game result independently selects samurai, dragon, ice wizard, lightning knight, phoenix, gorilla, storm warrior, lion king, cosmic wizard or emerald archer with equal probability using fresh browser randomness and rejection sampling. Repeats are allowed. The choice remains fixed while changing views, revisiting the result or toggling animations within the same game. New games can choose again even when their final positions are identical. All current and future animated scenes must remain separate from the starred-king display: with Game End Animations on, show only the chosen scene, with no starred king during loading or after completion. With the setting off, show only the original winner-colored starred king. The existing confetti overlay continues unchanged in both modes. Cancellation and reduced-motion behavior are retained.

## Generation prompt

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite sheet for a miniature chess victory animation. Create one transparent RGBA image, exactly 4 columns by 2 rows of EIGHT equal rectangular cells. One complete SAME full-body dragon per cell, no overlaps, generous transparent space inside EVERY cell, no grid lines or lettering. Side profile facing RIGHT, head on the right and long curled tail on the left. A magnificent anatomically coherent black/charcoal dragon with ruby-red wing membranes, subtle bronze scale highlights, short swept-back horns and a bright amber eye. Elegant detailed fantasy game miniature, painted realistic 3D game art, crisp silhouette, warm rim lighting. It must read well at only 140px tall. Four sturdy legs, two wings, one head; identical identity, size, side-view camera and position across the cells. Feet near 82% of each cell height, main body centered, all wings, tail, horns fully INSIDE their own cell with at least 6% transparent margin. Reading left to right top row then bottom: 1 glide wings extended; 2 wing upstroke; 3 wing downstroke; 4 landed wings folded; 5 neck pulls back inhaling; 6 head stretches right jaws open about to breathe fire; 7 mouth slightly open recovering; 8 proud victory stance wings partly raised. NO actual flame, smoke, floor, scenery, chess pieces, shadows on ground or text: the app will add flame and pieces procedurally. Background truly transparent, not a checkerboard image. Every figure must be separate and completely intact, consistent natural scale and common baseline. Wide landscape sheet, preferably 2048x1024.
